browser.surface: Codex in-app Chromium via CUA accessibility and Playwright locators
notes: Live two-tab optimistic conflicts executed separately in Relay, Atelier and Trace.
Some pointer automation calls timed out; fresh accessibility inspection and direct accessible activation verified the controls.
Early screenshot attempts were replaced with verified viewport captures in JPEG format.
No production backend, SQL tests, remote deployment, real authentication, screen-reader certification or external model was exercised.
